description: This header file declares functions related to engine configuration and control, including initialization, status printing, scheduling engine stop, setting engine type, and retrieving configuration names.

methods.name: printSpiState
methods.description: Prints the SPI state using the provided logger and board configuration.

methods.name: setCallFromPitStop
methods.description: Sets a call from pit stop with specified duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: setEngineType
methods.description: Sets the engine type based on provided value.

methods.name: getConfigurationName
methods.description: Returns the configuration name for a given engine type.
